description: Create a temporary 24-hour Soundiiz import link for 1 to 200 supplied tracks. Show the exact returned shareUrl, including query parameters, and expiry. Preserve a requested destination and omit it otherwise. The user reviews the tracks and completes the transfer in Soundiiz. Omit unknown album or ISRC metadata. No music-service password or token is needed.

destination.description: Include only when the user requests a platform. Use its documented Soundiiz API corename; otherwise omit this field.

artists.description: Artist names as an array; use an empty array when unknown.

name: createSoundiizImportLink

expiresAt.description: Import expiry as a Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC).

httpStatus.description: HTTP status associated with this tool error.

retryAfter.description: Wait at least this many seconds before retrying.

title: Create a Soundiiz playlist import link
